title: Athena
hook: An AI spokesperson for my club — my first real step into applied LLMs.
text: An AI built from scratch to be the spokesperson for my club — my first true step into applied LLMs, and the build that changed how I see software.
highlights: Built from scratch as the club's spokesperson.
First applied LLM project, and the one that changed how I approach software.

caseStudy.problem: The club needed a voice that could answer for it online — without a person repeating the same introductions and answers.
caseStudy.approach: I built Athena from scratch around an LLM, shaping its role, knowledge and responses specifically for the club rather than adapting a generic chatbot.
caseStudy.outcome: Athena is live at athena.motionukict.com as the club's AI spokesperson.
caseStudy.learned: This was the build that made LLMs feel like a material rather than a demo. The interesting work is in what the model is given and how it is constrained.
